title: 3D Phylogenetic Tree with Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 3D phylogenetic tree visualization using Three.js (CDN: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r152/three.min.js) and OrbitControls (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.152.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js).

## Scene Setup
- Background color: #1a1a2e
- Perspective camera at position (0, 5, 15), looking at origin
- Ambient light (0xffffff, 0.4) and a directional light (0xffffff, 0.8) at (5, 10, 5)
- OrbitControls enabled for rotation/zoom

## Phylogenetic Tree Structure
Build a simple phylogenetic tree with 7 species nodes arranged in 3D space:
- Root node at (0, 0, 0), color green (#00ff88)
- Two internal nodes branching from root: NodeA at (-3, 3, 0) and NodeB at (3, 3, 0), color yellow (#ffcc00)
- From NodeA: Leaf1 at (-5, 6, -2), Leaf2 at (-1, 6, 2), color cyan (#00ccff)
- From NodeB: Leaf3 at (1, 6, -2), Leaf4 at (5, 6, 2), color cyan (#00ccff)

Each node is a SphereGeometry(0.3, 16, 16) with MeshStandardMaterial. Branches connecting parent-child nodes are CylinderGeometry or Line segments (use white color #ffffff, LineBasicMaterial).

Label each leaf node with a text sprite or HTML overlay: 'Species A', 'Species B', 'Species C', 'Species D'.

## Node Selection and Color Change Interaction
- Implement raycasting on mouse click to select tree nodes (spheres)
- When a node is clicked, it becomes 'selected' and its color changes to red (#ff0044)
- Only one node can be selected at a time; clicking another node deselects the previous one
- Clicking empty space deselects all nodes
- Each selection/deselection is recorded as an action for undo/redo

## Undo/Redo System
- Maintain an action history stack and a redo stack
- Add two HTML buttons: 'Undo' (id='undoBtn') and 'Redo' (id='redoBtn') in a HUD panel at the top-left corner
- Also display a text showing the number of actions in history: 'History: N' (id='historyCount')
- Pressing Undo reverts the last selection action (restores previous node colors)
- Pressing Redo re-applies the last undone action
- Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Z for Undo, Ctrl+Y for Redo
- When a new action is performed after undo, the redo stack is cleared

## State Management (window.__3D_STATE__)
Expose the following on window.__3D_STATE__:
- `nodeCount` (number): total number of tree nodes (should be 7)
- `selectedNodeId` (string|null): the name/id of the currently selected node, e.g., 'Root', 'NodeA', 'NodeB', 'Leaf1', 'Leaf2', 'Leaf3', 'Leaf4', or null if none selected
- `historyLength` (number): number of actions in the undo history stack
- `redoLength` (number): number of actions in the redo stack
- `nodeColors` (object): mapping of node id to current hex color integer, e.g., { Root: 0x00ff88, NodeA: 0xffcc00, ... }
- `branchCount` (number): total number of branch connections (should be 6)
- `sceneReady` (boolean): true once the scene is fully initialized

Name each sphere mesh with its node id string (mesh.name = 'Root', 'NodeA', etc.).

## HUD Styling
- Position buttons and history counter in a semi-transparent dark panel at top-left
- Style buttons with padding, border-radius, and hover effects
- Font: monospace, color white
physics_constraints: No physics simulation required. Tree node positions are static. Undo/redo must correctly restore node color states without data loss or corruption.
